title: Among superheroes published by Marvel Comics who are aligned as 'Bad', find
question: Among superheroes published by Marvel Comics who are aligned as 'Bad', find the difference between the count of those with green skin and those with missing weight data (weight_kg = 0 or NULL).

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_006 = 'Green' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.XCL_029 = 0 OR s.XCL_029 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero AS s
INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
INNER JOIN alignment AS a ON s.XCL_027 = a.XCL_001
INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_024 = c.XCL_005
WHERE p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND a.XCL_002 = 'Bad'
